title: ORNL - Analysis of a Metallic Specimen
doc_notes: This is an archival report from the All-Domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO) detailing the scientific analysis of a metallic specimen; it contains a physical trace encounter claim which the document concludes is terrestrial.

encounters.summary: A metallic specimen, claimed to be recovered from a 1947 UAP crash, was analyzed to determine if it was of non-terrestrial origin or functioned as a terahertz waveguide.
encounters.quote: the material is terrestrial in origin
